en.tagline: Search, install, update and publish skills with the ClawdHub CLI
en.summary: This skill documents the ClawdHub CLI, a command line tool for finding, installing, updating and publishing agent skills from clawdhub.com. It covers the commands for each of these tasks, plus login and listing installed skills. It is useful when you want to manage skill folders from a terminal instead of by hand.
problem: Agent skills live on a registry, and getting the right version into your project means finding it, downloading it and keeping it current. Doing this by hand is slow and easy to get wrong when you have several skills.
With this skill, you use the clawdhub CLI for each step. You can search the registry, install a skill at a given version, update one skill or all of them, and publish a skill folder you have changed.
fit: Installing a skill you found on clawdhub.com into a local skills folder
Keeping several installed skills up to date, or pinning one to a specific version
Publishing a new or changed skill folder to the registry
unfit: Writing or editing a skill's contents, since the skill only covers the CLI commands
Using a skill registry other than clawdhub.com without changing the registry setting
steps: Install the CLI globally with `npm i -g clawdhub`.
Run `clawdhub login` and `clawdhub whoami` to authenticate before publishing.
Use `clawdhub search` to find skills and `clawdhub install` to add one, optionally with `--version`.
Run `clawdhub update` on one skill or with `--all`; it hashes local files, finds the matching version, and upgrades to latest unless `--version` is set.
Run `clawdhub list` to see installed skills.
Run `clawdhub publish` with a folder, slug, name, version and changelog to release a skill.

zh.tagline: 用 ClawdHub CLI 搜索、安装、更新和发布技能
zh.summary: 这个技能介绍 ClawdHub CLI，这是一个命令行工具，用于从 clawdhub.com 查找、安装、更新和发布智能体技能。文中列出了每项任务的命令，还包括登录和列出已安装技能。如果你希望在终端中管理技能文件夹，而不是手动操作，它会有帮助。
problem: 智能体技能存放在注册表中。要把正确的版本放进项目，需要先找到它、下载它，并保持更新。技能较多时手动操作既慢又容易出错。
使用这个技能后，每一步都通过 clawdhub CLI 完成。你可以搜索注册表，安装指定版本的技能，更新单个或全部技能，并发布你修改过的技能文件夹。
fit: 把在 clawdhub.com 找到的技能安装到本地 skills 文件夹
让多个已安装的技能保持最新，或将某个技能固定到指定版本
把新建或修改过的技能文件夹发布到注册表
unfit: 编写或修改技能内容，因为该技能只涵盖 CLI 命令
使用 clawdhub.com 以外的技能注册表，且不修改注册表设置
steps: 用 `npm i -g clawdhub` 全局安装 CLI。
运行 `clawdhub login` 和 `clawdhub whoami` 完成认证，之后才能发布。
用 `clawdhub search` 查找技能，用 `clawdhub install` 安装，可选加 `--version` 指定版本。
对单个技能或使用 `--all` 运行 `clawdhub update`；它会对本地文件做哈希，找到匹配的版本，除非设置了 `--version`，否则升级到最新版。
运行 `clawdhub list` 查看已安装的技能。
运行 `clawdhub publish`，传入文件夹、slug、名称、版本和变更说明，以发布技能。
